<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'parsed entity value'> ">
  %pe;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- Main root element comment containing <tags> & entities -->
  <sub:child sub:id="1">
    <?sub-pi target="data" content="processing instruction value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with special characters: <root>&ent;</root>
    ]]>
    &ent;
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Standard Item">
  <!ENTITY combined "&base; - Extended">
  <!ENTITY % dtd_macro "<!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtd_macro;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/schema" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Inventory header comment -->
  <item xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <![CDATA[
      Item description inside CDATA with &combined; reference inside text.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <note>
    <?xml-debug log="true"?>
    &combined;
  </note>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (product)*>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha Product">
  <!ENTITY beta "α & Beta Product">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-target processing-instruction-data?>
<catalog xmlns="http://catalog.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://catalog.org/meta">
  <!-- Catalog section comment: check entity resolution & CDATA handling -->
  <meta:details>
    <?meta-pi load="config"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block: <catalog><product>β</product></catalog>
    ]]>
  </meta:details>
  <product>β</product>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "Record Entity One">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Two">
  <!ENTITY % ext_macro "<!ENTITY ent3 'Macro Entity'>">
  %ext_macro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns" xmlns:custom="http://archive.org/custom">
  <!-- Archive description comment block -->
  <custom:record custom:index="0">
    <?custom-pi action="verify"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw record contents: &ent2; &ent3;
    ]]>
  </custom:record>
  <record>&ent2;</record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY headline "Important Notice">
  <!ENTITY message "&headline;: Please read carefully.">
  <!ENTITY % inline_macro "<!ATTLIST section id ID #REQUIRED>">
  %inline_macro;
]>
<?xml-app-info status="active"?>
<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:ns="http://doc.org/ns/ext">
  <!-- Top-level comment for document root -->
  <section id="s1" ns:type="primary">
    <?ns-pi test="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block enclosing markup: <ns:section>&message;</ns:section>
    ]]>
    &message;
  </section>
</document>
```
